title: These towels shed!!
text: These towels shed!!. I would not recommend these towels. They were great the first few days we used them. As soon as we washed them in the washing machine - GAME OVER. They are cheaply made - they constantly shed link on your skin. Note to self: do not use these to dry your hands right before putting your contacts in! Lesson learned. I would not recommend purchasing these - they are other towels in a similar price point that do not shed.
